description: This Java class 'SagePayServices' provides methods for integrating with SagePay payment gateway, including payment authentication, authorization, release, void, and refund operations. It constructs HTTP requests, handles responses, and manages payment transaction states within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SagePayServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to handle SagePay payment gateway operations such as authentication, authorization, release, void, and refund within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: buildSagePayProperties
methods.description: Builds and retrieves SagePay configuration properties from the database based on the provided context and delegator.

methods.name: paymentAuthentication
methods.description: Performs payment authentication with SagePay, constructing request parameters, sending HTTP POST, and processing the response.

methods.name: paymentAuthorisation
methods.description: Handles payment authorization, sending relevant data to SagePay and interpreting the response.

methods.name: paymentRelease
methods.description: Releases a payment (captures funds) through SagePay, managing request and response.

methods.name: paymentVoid
methods.description: Voids a payment transaction via SagePay, sending void request and handling response.

methods.name: paymentRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund through SagePay, constructing refund request, executing, and interpreting response.
